title: Courier confirms order was left at the wrong address
facts_text: I verified my account and order. The app says the order was delivered, but I did not receive it. Support contacted the courier, who confirmed that the order was left at a different address. The restaurant confirmed that it handed the order to the courier.
request: Please refund the full order, including the delivery and service fees.

strict.reason: The account and order are verified, and the courier confirmed the order was left at the wrong address.

exception.reason: The order is verified as undelivered, so the full-refund rule applies without needing the late-item exception.
